about.title: About
about.description: I help cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, and small businesses in Bolzano create mobile-friendly websites, online menus, booking flows, and simple admin tools that make it easier for customers to contact, order, or reserve.

whatIBuild.title: Business Websites
whatIBuild.description: Mobile-first websites for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, and salons. Fast, clean, and built to turn visitors into customers.

whatIBuild.title: Online Ordering Systems
whatIBuild.description: Digital menus with order-ahead and pickup functionality. Customers browse and order from their phone — no app required.

whatIBuild.title: Booking & Reservation Tools
whatIBuild.description: Online appointment scheduling for salons, studios, and restaurants. Clients book, you get notified, availability updates automatically.

whatIBuild.title: Admin Dashboards
whatIBuild.description: Private panels to manage orders, update menus, view bookings, and track activity. Simple enough for anyone to use.

whyItWorks.title: Built for Mobile
whyItWorks.description: Every site and tool is designed for phone users first — because that is where your customers are.

whyItWorks.title: WhatsApp Ready
whyItWorks.description: Integrated WhatsApp so customers can reach you instantly, the way people actually communicate today.

whyItWorks.title: Simple to Manage
whyItWorks.description: You get an easy dashboard to update content, view orders, and manage bookings — no tech skills needed.

whyItWorks.title: Local & Multilingual
whyItWorks.description: Based in Bolzano, serving in German, Italian, and English. I understand the local market and your customers.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Real projects I have built. Each one is designed to solve a real problem for a local business.

projects.title: Bakery Ordering Website
projects.description: Designed and developed a premium bakery website with a product-focused menu section, custom cake flow, responsive layout, and polished brand styling for a home bakery concept.

projects.title: Restaurant / Cafe Ordering Demo
projects.description: A QR-code-based ordering system for restaurants and cafes. Customers scan, browse, and order from their phones.
features: QR code menu at every table

projects.title: Salon Booking Demo
projects.description: An online booking system for salons and beauty studios. Clients book appointments, pick services, and get reminders.

services.title: Services
services.description: Everything a local business needs to thrive online — from a simple website to a complete ordering and booking system.

items.title: Business Websites

items.title: Online Ordering Tools
